hypothesis: For a declared pairwise preference problem, local edits in similar semantic contexts might carry a transferable preference direction. Test whether an agent can learn when to mix a general nearest-example vote with the independently scored incumbent using only training feedback. No dataset identifiers or natural-language task terms are model inputs.
anchor: Look up the ordinary single model selected by the prior unconstrained raw run, read its fitted vector provider, and reuse the exact existing per-fold incumbent probability records from the two registered regrouped five-fold partitions. Do not manually select another encoder or estimate neighborhoods on held labels.
neighbours: For each group-disjoint fitting partition, index sentence-vector differences and midpoints separately, each L2-normalized. The absolute cosine between changes handles either orientation; a positive midpoint cosine weights semantic context. Rank by their product, take at most one row per connected training group, at most sqrt(groups) clipped to [3,40]. The vote from a row is its signed label times the sign of the directional cosine. Square similarity weights and use symmetric shrinkage towards a zero signed vote with one unit of the mean retained weight on each side. Identical input sides have probability one half. No global cross-fitted labels or held examples enter an index.
selection: Each held fold is split by a fixed SHA256('analogy vote selection v1/'+connected_group) modulo 2. In each direction, use one half to pick the blend weight in [0,.25,.5,1] that maximizes the actual declared accuracy, resolving ties towards less change. Evaluate on the disjoint half and then reverse the roles. Report unchanging anchor, standalone retrieval, fixed quarter blend and feedback-chosen blend. Count each label-bearing retrieval index as one fit and each blend decision separately.
advance: For promotion to a full raw-agent candidate test, the feedback-chosen blend must gain at least 0.20 accuracy percentage points on each of the two pre-existing partitions, be nonnegative on at least six of ten folds, and lose at most 0.50 percentage points on every fold. The two allocations reuse the same training examples; results are sensitivity evidence. No course designated validation, official test, paid API or H2. No method, group name or blend weight may enter the shipped controller on the strength of a single development result.
